summary: The leader window's tooltips: the panel's routine, a row's, the traits to gain, a trait's name and effects, the trait filter's rows; and the leader's own tooltip's command line corrected.

addresses.name: CLeaderAssignmentPanel::ElementTooltip
addresses.signature: GuiTooltipText* __stdcall CLeaderAssignmentPanel::ElementTooltip(CLeaderAssignmentPanel* panel, GuiTooltipText* out, CGuiObject* element) @EAX
addresses.comment: The leader window's tooltips, asked only by CUnitView::BuildTooltip while the window is shown. In order: the trait filter where its window (+0x1E8 -> +4) is shown and holds the element (0x767110) - final; the `leaderlist` row that holds it (CLeaderAssignmentEntry::ElementTooltip), standing where it has a text or a delayed; then by name: `gaintrait_info` the traits to gain of the window's leader (+0x1E0, 0x765D40), `selected_photo` his slot 9, `trait_icon` the trait named by the element's +8 (slot 6 text, slot 7 delayed), `filter_traits` TRAIT_FILTER_DESC. Anything else empty, so the header goes on with its own names. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leadertooltips.md, section 2.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; `ret 0xC` at 0x768298 and 0x7687C5; the one call at 0x76A2B4 pushes the element, the out and the panel. Wrong if the call site's third push were not the panel at CUnitView +0x34.

addresses.name: CLeaderAssignmentEntry::ElementTooltip
addresses.signature: GuiTooltipText* __stdcall CLeaderAssignmentEntry::ElementTooltip(CLeaderAssignmentEntry* entry, GuiTooltipText* out, void* element)
addresses.comment: A row of the leader window: empty unless its leader (+0x28, an id pair) resolves; then `gaintrait_info` his traits to gain (0x765D40), `trait_icon` the trait named by the element's +8 (slot 6 into text, slot 7 into delayed), `photo` his slot 9. Anything else empty, and the panel's routine then goes on by name. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leadertooltips.md, section 3.
addresses.revises: Read whole: was read for its shape only.

addresses.name: LeaderTraitsToGainTooltip
addresses.comment: The `gaintrait_info` icon's tooltip: the leader's tracker (+0xC4) CTraitGainTracker::BuildProgressTooltip; empty, NO_TRAIT_TO_GAIN_DESC; otherwise TO_GAIN_TRAITS_DESC + "\n" + the progress lines. All in text. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leadertooltips.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; bare `ret`; both callers load the leader into EDX and push the out, 0x7683D1..0x7683E3 cleaning 4. Wrong if ECX carried anything the body reads.

addresses.name: LeaderTraitFilters_ElementTooltip
addresses.signature: GuiTooltipText* __stdcall LeaderTraitFilters_ElementTooltip(void* filters@EAX, GuiTooltipText* out@ESI, CGuiObject* element@stack:4) @EAX
addresses.comment: The trait filter window's tooltips: of its list (+8), the first row whose window (+0x1C) holds the element by slot 22, that row's CTraitFilterEntry::ElementTooltip; with none an empty tooltip. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leadertooltips.md, section 2.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; `ret 4`; the call at 0x76824C loads the filter object from panel +0x1E8 into EAX and the out into ESI and pushes the element.

addresses.name: CTraitFilterEntry::ElementTooltip
addresses.signature: GuiTooltipText* __stdcall CTraitFilterEntry::ElementTooltip(CTraitFilterEntry* entry, GuiTooltipText* out, CGuiObject* element) @EAX
addresses.comment: A trait filter row: only on its checkbox `background` (+0x34): the trait's (+0x2C) slot 7, what it does, into text and TRAIT_FILTER_ENTRY_DESC into delayed. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leadertooltips.md, section 5.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; `ret 0xC`; the call at 0x767189 pushes the element, the out and the row. +0x34 is the checkbox found by the name `background` at 0x766C42..0x766C77.

addresses.name: CTrait::GetName
addresses.comment: Slot 6 of CTrait (and CNullTrait): the string at +0x48, the trait key's text as the constructor rendered it. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leadertooltips.md, section 5.
addresses.evidence: Read whole: constructs the out from +0x48, `ret 4`. Held at slot 6 of both tables (vtable.py).

addresses.name: CTrait::EffectsText
addresses.comment: Slot 7 of CTrait (and CNullTrait): a line per effect (TraitEffectLine of effect_kinds[i], effect_values[i], effect_types[i]), \n between them and none after the last. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leadertooltips.md, section 5.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; `ret 4`; the loop runs to effect_count (+0x2A8).

addresses.name: TraitEffectLine
addresses.signature: Hoi3CString* __stdcall TraitEffectLine(int kind@ECX, Hoi3CString* out@stack:4, int value@stack:8, Hoi3CString* terrain@stack:12) @EAX
addresses.comment: One effect of a trait as a line: the label by the kind (TRAIT_XP_GAIN .. TRAIT_DIGIN_BONUS for 0..26, none for 27 and 30, TRAIT_TERRAIN_SPEED and TRAIT_TERRAIN_ATTACK with TYPE the terrain's text for 28 and 29); ' §G' where the value - negated for supply consumption, winter attrition, encirclement and envelopment - is above 0, else ' §R'; '+' where the value is above 0; then the disengage timer (12) FormatFixedPoint(value, 0) and the rest FormatFixedPoint(value * 100000 / 1000, 0) + '%§W'. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leadertooltips.md, section 5.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; `ret 0xC`; the colour, sign and figure read in the listing 0x5B4173..0x5B4225, the three strings 0x15C341C ' §R', 0x15C3430 ' §G', 0x15C2148 '%§W' read as bytes. The one caller, CTrait::EffectsText, passes the kind in ECX.

addresses.name: CTraitDataBase_Find
addresses.comment: A trait by its key, or null: h = (h + c) * 61 over the name's bytes as signed chars, h modulo +4 into the buckets at +8, each a chain of (trait, next); a trait matches on its name's (+0x2C) length and bytes. 67 callers. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leadertooltips.md, section 5.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; `ret 4`; called with CTrait::database()'s result in EAX at 0x768530 and 0x766152.

addresses.name: CNullTrait_Instance
addresses.comment: A CNullTrait of its own, made on first use (0x2B4 bytes) and kept at 0x1A855E8 - not the one at index 0 of CTrait::database(). What a trait looked up by a key the database lacks falls back to. 8 callers. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leadertooltips.md, section 5.

addresses.name: CTrait::CTrait
addresses.signature: CTrait* __stdcall CTrait::CTrait(CTrait* storage, Hoi3CString* key, int index) @EAX
addresses.comment: CModifier's constructor, then the key at +0x2C, the index at +0x2AC, a save token for the key at +0x64, the key's text rendered into +0x48, sixteen empty effects and all three allowed bytes set. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leadertooltips.md, section 5.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; `ret 0xC`; the call at 0x5B4867 pushes a counter, the key and the storage.

addresses.name: CLeader::CLeader
addresses.comment: CLeader's own constructor: kind, rank, skill, most skill and experience (+0x68..+0x80) zeroed. CNullLeader's begins with it. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leadertooltips.md, section 7.
addresses.evidence: `ret 4`; the storage pushed at 0x57F3A1; the stores of ebx (0) at 0x57F609..0x57F6A1.

addresses.name: CLeader::BuildTooltip
addresses.comment: **Slot 9** of CLeader (vftable 0x15C5220) and CNullLeader (0x15C524C), read whole 2026-10-12: the rank's name, ` §Y`, his name; **the command size only where his unit (+0x40) is set and is a fleet or an air unit** (its slots 16 and 17), measured against that unit, with SHIPS_LABEL or PLANES_LABEL by that unit's slot 16 (corrected 2026-10-12: had been put as 'a leader of a fleet or an air unit'); an admiral's (+0x68 == 1) positioning; LEADER_SKILL (and LEADER_SKILL_AT_MAX); LEADER_XP; ACTUAL_TRAITS_DESC with `\n- §Y` each trait; TO_GAIN_TRAITS_DESC with the progress lines (CTraitGainTracker::BuildProgressTooltip, called at 0x58161F). Extent 0x580220..0x5817A0, `ret 4`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-unitpaneltooltips.md, section 13, and reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leadertooltips.md, section 7.
addresses.evidence: 0x5803F3..0x58041B: [leader+0x40] null skips to 0x58085D, else its slot 16 or slot 17; 0x580673..0x58068B the label by its slot 16.
addresses.revises: The command line's condition: his unit a fleet or an air unit, not his kind.

struct_fields.name: display_name
struct_fields.comment: The key's text, rendered once by the constructor; slot 6 (CTrait::GetName) returns it. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leadertooltips.md, section 5.
struct_fields.evidence: CTrait::CTrait 0x5B26F0 assigns the rendered text to +0x48; 0x5B29D0 copies it out.

struct_fields.name: bucket_count
struct_fields.comment: How many buckets the hash by name has; CTraitDataBase_Find takes the hash modulo it. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leadertooltips.md, section 5.

struct_fields.name: buckets
struct_fields.comment: The hash's buckets, each a chain of (trait, next). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leadertooltips.md, section 5.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x5B4E00: `*(int **)(*(int *)(in_EAX + 8) + index * 4)`, the node's +0 the trait and +4 the next.

notes: Whether the leader window is inside the unit panel's window, and so whether any of this is shown, was not settled: the window is made by the in-game screen's factory with the screen's +0x1794, not followed.
